column7: SCIM PATCH/PUT active=false (how Okta and Entra disable a user) terminated sessions but left PATs unrevoked: inert while blocked, valid again when the IdP re-enabled the account. scimUpdateUserTx now revokes every PAT in the deactivation transaction and the hashes are evicted after commit, as SCIM DELETE does (#2855). Red on main (ValidatePATToken succeeded after deactivate -> reactivate). Siblings: TestUpdateSCIMUser_DeactivateRevokesPATsAndKeepsAdminSuspension (admin suspension kept, no un-revoke), TestUpdateSCIMUser_PATRevokeFaultRollsBackDeactivation (a failed revoke rolls back the whole update).
